title: Garvin Bushell on regional styles
summary: Perhanis cites Garvin Bushell's account of New York, Midwest and Louisiana styles. Rose agrees New Orleans was rougher but says much music there was poor and New York had more technique.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
